description: This file contains a shell script for performing a device firmware upgrade on a specific hardware platform. It manages UBI volumes, sets environment variables, and executes the upgrade process tailored for an Initiator device using UBI and SquashFS filesystems.

methods.name: inteno_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main function to perform the firmware upgrade, handling UBI volume cleanup, resize, environment setup, and invoking the standard upgrade process.
